approach:
Attempt 2 fixes all five refusal reasons:
1. Title: replaced with a near-quote of the ticket ("Show which overdue invoices belong to vendors that usually pay late"). It no longer claims a risk ranking. CR-5 sorts by days descending, then by id.
2. Next step: removed every mention of REQ-02 and Grouping, which no source I read supports.
3. CMP-P01: removed. The regulatory row now repeats only what org.regulatory_sources says.
4. "Does not approve or prioritize": replaced with "Draft entry for review; gate: PM", taken from the brief.
5. Notification: called capabilities_list, which shows api:github is the only approved API and is GET only. Filed a capability_request for a notification channel. The entry now says the notification was not sent and the request is pending; the PM follow-up is Q-3.

The rest is unchanged from attempt 1. I re-used the inputs already read this session (the five contracted inputs, requirements/ZD-48600.md, and the related ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455) and rewrote both output files in full. No shell use was needed.

unsupported.text: A-2: `amount` in the CR-5 output is Decimal, and it is formatted to two decimals only when rendered in CR-6. (org.decision_log; file:hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ZD-48600.md)
unsupported.why: The source it cites says the opposite of 'only when rendered'. requirements/ZD-48600.md (org.architecture) says 'JSON between services carries amounts as strings with two decimals', and the overdue list passes from ap_aging to ap_portal as JSON. So amounts are also formatted to two decimals when serialised between services, not only in renderOverdueRisk. It is labelled as an assumption, but it misstates the source it cites.

judge.notes:
Attempt 2 fixes all five attempt-1 refusals. The title no longer claims a ranking by risk. The invented REQ-02, CMP-P01 and prioritisation statements are gone. The notification statement now cites a real capability_request: org/capability_requests.md line 3 records a REQUESTED notification channel for REQ-01, FEAT-ZD-48600.

What I checked against sources:
- feat.intake reproduces the record:intake text word for word.
- CR-0..CR-7 are a faithful split of the ticket.
- The data model, customer mapping, architecture and risk-map excerpts match the org_overrides in requirements/ZD-48600.md.
- The roadmap link (R-AP-12, Q4 2026, AP module, owner PM) and the non-link to R-AP-14 match org.roadmap.
- The regulatory, connector and model-dependency statements quote their inputs correctly. The connector gap (the feed v3 paid_date column is not covered by an inventory that 'speaks only about the ap_aging library') is a sound inference and is raised as Q-2.
- D-2026-031/044/050 match org.decision_log. L-007/L-011 match record:memory.
- The related items ZD-48501, ZD-48211 and ZD-48455 are all status open. Their quoted overlaps (badge-overdue, the 'more than 30 days past its due date' wording, row-overdue) match the files.
- 'GET only' for api:github is supported by the brief's '(GET /repos/<owner>/<repo>/...)'.

Remaining gaps against the workbook outcome:
- The notification was not sent. A capability is requested instead, which is disclosed honestly.
- The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not checked. requirements/ files were used as a substitute, which is disclosed in Q-1.
- The 'triggered another agent' part of the outcome is not addressed.

Minor issue: assumption A-2 misstates the cited architecture (see unsupported). The assumptions are otherwise clearly labelled and grounded, and the open questions are useful for the PM gate.
